sources.title: Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervention in abrupt board reversal
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
Nvidia (NVDA.O), opens new tab reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday under pressure from US President Donald Trump, a stunning reversal following his resignation over revelations of extramarital affairs, drawing approval from Wall Street and opposition from US lawmakers.

Huang's comeback caps a whirlwind week of events that roiled markets and tore through the AI ecosystem that has relied on Nvidia for everything from supplying chips to bankrolling the industry's massive buildout.

But the board's about-face — less than a week after Chair Harvey Jones said Nvidia would not rehire Huang as CEO because his personal behavior was inconsistent with the company's code of conduct — raises questions about its independence, governance experts said, even as the company's investigation remains unfinished.

Huang's comeback boosted Wall Street and sent Nvidia's shares soaring. The stock closed up 31.5%, adding nearly $1 trillion in market value, vaulting the chipmaker back to the position of the second-biggest company by market value after Apple.

sources.title: 《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》发布
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
新华社北京11月23日电（记者 何晓）“一老一小”事关亿万家庭福祉和国家长远发展。记者23日从国家发展改革委获悉，为贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于促进人口高质量发展的决策部署，扩大养老、托育服务有效供给，日前，经国务院同意，国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委、教育部印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》。

实施方案明确，到2030年，养老、托育服务设施布局更加合理、条件明显改善，医养结合持续深化，“一老一小”服务体系进一步健全、供需适配度进一步提高，养老机构护理型床位占比达到73%，社区养老服务机构和设施覆盖率达到70%，3岁以下婴幼儿入托率较2025年提高6个百分点，覆盖城乡、布局合理、价格可接受、质量有保障的普惠养老、托育服务供给格局基本形成。

实施方案围绕优化资源布局、提升服务品质、完善管理模式、健全保障措施等方面提出明确工作任务和目标要求，包括推动医养结合服务设施有序扩容；加快智能技术在养老、托育领域落地应用；探索构建城乡养老服务联合体；加大资金、土地、人才等要素支撑。
sources.limits: 原文公布政策目标，未给出当前覆盖率或资金预算，目标不应误写为已实现成效。

sources.title: China announces measures to steady stock market
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
BEIJING, Nov. 23 (Xinhua) -- China will roll out a slew of measures to steady the stock market, including lowering the minimum margin requirement for leveraged stock purchases to generate incremental funds, the country's securities regulator said Sunday.

With approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges will lower the minimum margin ratio from 100 percent to 80 percent, effective from Nov. 30, according to the CSRC.

The adjustment is estimated to theoretically bring in nearly 400 billion yuan (about 59.58 billion U.S. dollars) in incremental funds.

sources.title: 上海证券交易所适度降低融资保证金比例 促进两融业务功能有效发挥
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
2023年8月27日，经中国证监会批准，上海证券交易所（以下简称上交所）修改了《上海证券交易所融资融券交易实施细则（2023年修订）》第三十九条，将融资保证金比例从100%降低至80%，此次调整将于2023年9月8日收市后正式实施。

融资保证金比例，是指投资者融资买入时交付的保证金与融资交易金额的比例。例如，当融资保证金比例为100%时，投资者用100万元的保证金最多可以向证券公司融资100万元买入证券。而当融资保证金比例降低至80%时，客户用100万元的保证金最多可以向证券公司融资125万元买入证券。
sources.limits: 历史规则为上交所规则文本；比较对象为相同融资买入最低保证金比例。

sources.title: Nvidia board’s Huang reversal raises doubts about independence, critics say
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
Nvidia’s board undermined its claims of independence by reinstating CEO Jensen Huang before investigations into his conduct concluded, investors and corporate governance experts said.

The decision is striking because the board effectively vouched for Huang’s candor and fitness to lead the company before its own investigation was complete, raising doubts about whether directors had sufficient information to make an independent judgment, these people said.

Nvidia said on Monday that after talks with senior US officials, its board "is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk."

The abrupt U-turn, just days after the board vowed to look elsewhere for a successor, has also drawn US President Donald Trump and his administration into Nvidia’s corporate governance. Nvidia shares closed 31.5% higher on Monday even as it was becoming clear that the chipmaker’s board acted under pressure from Trump and others, and the president took credit for the change.

The company said an independent board committee is still investigating reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, and said "the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion," with Huang’s cooperation.
sources.limits: Reuters报道引述投资者及治理专家观点；公司调查仍在进行，报道不构成独立核实。

sources.title: Japan cuts view on consumer spending for 1st time since 2024
sources.method: Pi搜索 mcp__exa__web_search_exa + 原文读取 mcp__exa__web_fetch_exa
sources.excerpt:
TOKYO, Nov 24 (Reuters) - The Japanese government downgraded its view on consumer spending in November for the first time in more than 2-1/2 years as rising prices weighed on consumer sentiment.

On private consumption, the government cut its view on consumer spending for the first time since February 2024, saying it "appears to be pausing for picking up." In October, it said spending was "showing movements of picking up."

On exports, the government upgraded its view for the first time since June, to "showing movements of picking up," as shipments to the US and EU picked up. On industrial production, authorities raised their assessment for the first time since September, saying it was "picking up as a whole."
